# Abdur Rakib

> Official knowledge summary and LLM context feed for Abdur Rakib, Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Programming Hero.

## Executive Profile
- **Full Name**: Abdur Rakib (also known as Rakib Vai, Abdur Rakib Zero)
- **Current Role**: Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Programming Hero (Bangladesh's leading ed-tech & tech career platform)
- **Domain Expertise**: Software engineering operations, high-throughput developer placement infrastructure, AI-era tech hiring standards, curriculum and mentorship systemization.
- **Experience**: 10+ years spanning freelance development, agency software engineering, engineering team leadership, and executive operations.
- **Placement Track Record**: Over 6,300+ junior software engineers placed across 57+ countries, contributing to 150+ placements monthly.
- **Decade Mission (2030)**: Target of 10,000 global tech placements per year by 2030 (In Sha' Allah).

## Core Operating Philosophy
- "AI raised the bar for junior developers. Motivation does not clear it. Systems do."
- Careers and technical fluency are built through boring, disciplined habits, structured accountability, and verifiable production builds rather than short-lived motivation.
